def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = next(c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1)
    width = min(sep, w - sep - 1)
    left = [row[:width] for row in grid]
    right = [row[sep + 1:sep + 1 + width] for row in grid]

    # The marked locations are where the two pattern halves overlap.
    left_color = max({v for row in left for v in row},
                     key=lambda v: sum(x == v for row in left for x in row))
    right_color = max({v for row in right for v in row},
                      key=lambda v: sum(x == v for row in right for x in row))

    return [[3 if left[r][c] == left_color and right[r][c] == right_color else 4
             for c in range(width)] for r in range(h)]

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The divider is the constant column between the two equal-sized fields.
    div = next(c for c in range(w)
               if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h))
               and c > 0 and c < w - 1)
    n = min(div, w - div - 1)
    left = [row[div - n:div] for row in grid]
    right = [row[div + 1:div + 1 + n] for row in grid]

    # Each field has its own background; mark only locations where both
    # fields contain a non-background cell.
    lbg = max(set(x for row in left for x in row),
              key=lambda x: sum(v == x for row in left for v in row))
    rbg = max(set(x for row in right for x in row),
              key=lambda x: sum(v == x for row in right for v in row))
    return [[3 if left[r][c] != lbg and right[r][c] != rbg else 4
             for c in range(n)] for r in range(h)]

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    divider = next(c for c in range(w)
                   if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h))
                   and c > 0 and c < w - 1)
    left_width = divider
    right_width = w - divider - 1
    width = min(left_width, right_width)

    # Mark the aligned locations where both fields contain their non-background
    # colors. The background on each side is the most frequent value.
    left = [grid[r][divider - width:divider] for r in range(h)]
    right = [grid[r][divider + 1:divider + 1 + width] for r in range(h)]

    def background(region):
        values = [v for row in region for v in row]
        return max(set(values), key=values.count)

    lb, rb = background(left), background(right)
    return [[3 if left[r][c] != lb and right[r][c] != rb else 4
             for c in range(width)] for r in range(h)]

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter

    # Select the uniform divider column with a color different from the
    # dominant background color.
    all_counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = all_counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    div = next(c for c in range(w)
               if 0 < c < w - 1
               and all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h))
               and grid[0][c] != background)

    left = [row[:div] for row in grid]
    right = [row[div + 1:] for row in grid]
    width = min(div, w - div - 1)

    def bg(part):
        counts = Counter(v for row in part for v in row)
        return counts.most_common(1)[0][0]

    lb, rb = bg(left), bg(right)
    return [[3 if left[r][c] != lb and right[r][c] != rb else 4
             for c in range(width)] for r in range(h)]
